neighbours.label: the token 'guard' (noun or verb, incl. '-guard' in closely-guarded)
fire: Two soldiers stood guard outside the palace gates.
The goalkeeper let his guard down in the final minute.
Late that night a security guard found the door unlocked.
Wear a mouth guard when you play hockey.
The hackers caught the bank's staff off guard.
The dog was trained to guard the farm at night.
The method remains a closely-guarded industry secret.
The national guard was called in after the flood.

The dog was trained to protect the farm at night.

The army was called in after the flood.
